categories.name: Garment Care
categories.description: Dry and steam irons engineered for reliable heating, performance and everyday use — with non-stick soleplate coating, snap-action thermostats, fast and uniform heat distribution and 360° swivel cords.

products.name: Dry Iron
products.shortDescription: Classic Elite series dry iron — steady temperature and a smooth non-stick glide for everyday ironing.
products.description: The GM-02 from the Classic Elite series is a dry iron rated at 1100W, built around german weilburger non-stick soleplate coating on a durable metal body construction. A snap-action thermostat, silver-layered thermostat contacts, keeps heat steady, while the 360° swivel cord and fast & uniform heat distribution bring reliable, everyday ironing for domestic and commercial use.

images.alt: G.M. Consolidated GM-02 Dry Iron - product photo
A dry iron gliding over a shirt during ironing - representative garment-care use
Press operator ironing garments in a laundry workshop

highlights.title: Snap-action thermostat
highlights.description: A snap-action thermostat holds a reliable set temperature for consistent, repeatable ironing results.

highlights.title: Non-stick soleplate finish
highlights.description: A durable non-stick soleplate coating gives a smooth glide across most fabric groups.

highlights.title: 360° swivel cord
highlights.description: A swivel cord that follows natural hand movement to reduce pull on the iron during use.

features: High Heat Retention Internal Base Cast
manufacturingNotes: Bodies and handles are tooled and moulded in-house in the G.M. tool room
Soleplate and heating element sub-assemblies are fitted on dedicated assembly stations
